# Theres something up in the skies....
### This datapack adds a whole new dimension, the Alpha Islands!

It consists of **3 new biomes**, the Sky Forest, Plains and Desert, each with different looks.

You can get there by getting beyond the buid limit via elytra, launchers... or the new **Potion of Flight**!

Theres also a new structure located in the Overworld, wonder what it could be...
